# GetPDF360

> Free, private online PDF tools. No sign-up, no watermark, no daily limit. Seven tools run entirely in the browser so files are never uploaded; the others delete files immediately after download.

## Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://getpdf360.com/merge-pdf): Combine PDFs in the order you want
- [Split PDF](https://getpdf360.com/split-pdf): Take out pages or split every page
- [Compress PDF](https://getpdf360.com/compress-pdf): Make PDFs smaller for email
- [PDF to Word](https://getpdf360.com/pdf-to-word): Get an editable DOCX file
- [Word to PDF](https://getpdf360.com/word-to-pdf): Turn DOC and DOCX into PDF
- [PDF to JPG](https://getpdf360.com/pdf-to-jpg): Save pages as images
- [JPG to PDF](https://getpdf360.com/jpg-to-pdf): Turn photos into one PDF
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://getpdf360.com/powerpoint-to-pdf): Turn slides into a PDF
- [Excel to PDF](https://getpdf360.com/excel-to-pdf): Turn spreadsheets into PDF
- [Rotate PDF](https://getpdf360.com/rotate-pdf): Fix sideways pages
- [Add page numbers](https://getpdf360.com/add-page-numbers): Number pages for printing
- [Edit PDF](https://getpdf360.com/edit-pdf): Add text, white-out, draw or sign
- [OCR PDF](https://getpdf360.com/ocr-pdf): Scans and photos into editable text
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://getpdf360.com/pdf-to-powerpoint): Turn a PDF into PPTX slides
- [Compress PDF to 100 KB](https://getpdf360.com/compress-pdf-to-100kb): shrink a PDF to under 100 KB for forms and uploads
- [Compress PDF to 200 KB](https://getpdf360.com/compress-pdf-to-200kb): shrink a PDF to under 200 KB for forms and uploads
- [Compress PDF to 500 KB](https://getpdf360.com/compress-pdf-to-500kb): shrink a PDF to under 500 KB for forms and uploads
- [Compress PDF to 1 MB](https://getpdf360.com/compress-pdf-to-1mb): shrink a PDF to under 1 MB for forms and uploads
